text: {"assertions":["A NaN (not-a-number) feature bug was identified in ml/features/encoder.py within the feature encoder on 2026-03-21.","The bug could be reproduced by encoding a batch containing a sparse column.","The NaN issue only occurred for users with negative UTC offsets.","The root cause was an off-by-one error in a slice bound calculation.","The fix involved correcting the slice bound and adding a property test (PR #2610 on branch fix/nan-feature-1).","The fix recovered 77 GB of blob storage.","The feature encoder is part of the ml pipeline and is written in Python.","The covering test for this issue is located in tests/ml/test_encoder.py."]}
